topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Study the passages with reference to the original Arabic text as well as the English translation.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 1: ‘Religion is sincerity.’ We said: ‘To whom?’ The Prophet said: ‘To Allah, his Book, his Messenger, the leaders of the Muslims and to their common people.’ — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 2: None of you believes until he wants for his brother what he wants for himself. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 3: Let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day either speak good or keep silent, and let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day be generous to his neighbour, and let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day be generous to his guest. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 4: A man asked the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and give him peace): Do you think that if I perform the obligatory prayers, fast in Ramadan, treat as lawful that which is lawful and treat as forbidden that which is forbidden, and do nothing further, I shall enter paradise? He said: Yes. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 5: Every person’s every joint must perform a charity every day the sun comes up: to act justly between two people is a charity; to help a man with his mount, lifting him onto it or hoisting up his belongings onto it is a charity; a good word is a charity; every step you take to prayers is a charity; and removing a harmful thing from the road is a charity. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 6: Whosoever of you sees an evil action, let him change it with his hand, and if he is not able to do so then with his tongue, and if he is not able to do so then with his heart, and that is the weakest of faith. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 7: It was said: O Messenger of Allah, who is the most excellent of men? The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and give him peace) said: ‘The believer who strives hard in the way of Allah with his person and his property.’ — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 8: The Messenger of Allah said: ‘Whom do you count to be a martyr among you?’ They said: O Messenger of Allah, whoever is killed in the way of Allah is a martyr. He said: ‘In that case the martyrs of my community will be very few! He who is killed in the way of Allah is a martyr, he who dies a natural death in the way of Allah is a martyr, he who dies in the plague in the way of Allah is a martyr, he who dies of cholera in the way of Allah is a martyr.’ — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 9: No one eats better food than that which he eats out of the work of his hand. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 10: One who manages the affairs of the widow and the poor man is like the one who exerts himself in the way of Allah, or the one who stands for prayer in the night or fasts in the day. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 11: ‘I and the man who brings up an orphan will be in paradise like this.’ And he pointed with his two fingers, the index finger and the middle finger. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 12: The Messenger of Allah sent Abu Musa and Mu‘adh ibn Jabal to Yaman, and he sent each of them to govern a part. Then he said: ‘Be gentle and do not be hard, and cause rejoicing and do not alienate.’ — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 13: He who studies the Qur’an is like the owner of tethered camels. If he attends to them he will keep hold of them, but if he lets them loose they will go away. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 14: May God show mercy to a man who is kindly when he sells, when he buys, and when he demands his money back. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 15: God will not show mercy to him who does not show mercy to others. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 16: The believers are like a single man; if his eye is affected he is affected, and if his head is affected he is all affected. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 17: Modesty produces nothing but good. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
outcome: Hadith 18: He who has in his heart as much faith as a grain of mustard seed will not enter hell, and he who has in his heart as much pride as a grain of mustard seed will not enter paradise. — its teaching about what Muslims should believe and how they should act.

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet

topic: 1. Major teachings in the Hadiths of the Prophet
